measurement_contract.pressure: Held at0 before0.3 seconds, ramps to1 between0.3 and0.6 seconds at block boundaries; stops updating after note-off.
measurement_contract.rms: Maximum among complete, nonoverlapping2205-frame (50ms) windows; energy is the mean of left and right squared samples. Final incomplete RMS window is not used; peaks and finiteness include all rendered samples.
measurement_contract.limits: This deterministic short phrase plus fixed eight-note chord is an acceptance fixture, not proof for every performance, register, arbitrarily long evolving patch, or possible MIDI/control sequence.

calibration.algorithm: Gain in dB is the minimum of RMS target deficit, phrase-peak headroom, and stress-peak headroom. Multiply existing master trim by10^(gainDb/20), clamp to0.05..1, and write measured trims only.
calibration.rebuild_requirement: Rebuild the audit executable after pass1 so pass2 measures the newly compiled trim table, then rebuild final consumers after pass2. The second pass compensates for the mildly nonlinear output stage; success must still be established by the unchanged final audit.
calibration.saturation_limit: A master trim already at1 cannot rescue an overly quiet recipe. This correction keeps that bound and raises appropriate internal rank levels; it does not substitute a calibration return code for the full acceptance audit.
calibration.final_source_status: Parent has not completed final-source recalibration/audit at this review point.
